limitations: Extractive, turn-level rows only. An AI-compressed row returns UNSUPPORTED_DERIVATION instead of a verdict.
Read-only over the session JSONL and the memory export; no memory store is opened or written.
One sha256 per pinned line. That is tamper-evidence for a pinned event, not an append-only log.
The m1 demand half (2+ users describing confabulated memory in their own words) is a research gate, not something the CLI can prove.
